label: narrative clause-boundary tokens
explanation: It fires on tokens in English narrative/list passages that are at or just after sentence, clause, or list boundaries marked by punctuation, line breaks, or conjunctions. Early sequence positions fire more often but weakly, while later positions and denser narrative/list contexts such as film plots and cast lists fire more strongly; non-narrative text fires only weakly or not.
